sections.section: RULES - Post Office Savings Bank Rules
sections.description:
POST OFFICE SAVINGS BANK RULES
POST OFFICE SAVINGS BANK
RULES
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
13th August, 2011]
S.R.O.
760(I)/2011, dated 11-8-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section
28 of the Public Debt Act, 1944 (XVIII of 1944), the Federal Government is
pleased to direct that the following further amendments shall be made in the
Post Office Savings Bank Rules the same
having been previously published vide Notification No.S.R.O.589(I)/2011, dated
the 8th June, 2011, as required under subsection (1) of the said section,
namely:--
In
the aforesaid Rules,--
(i) in
rule 5, in sub-rule (1), in clause (a), for sub-clause (iv), the following
shall be substituted, namely:--
"(iv) all institutional investment shall be
discontinued with immediate effect and no future deposit shall be accepted in
the accounts already opened by firms and institutions."; and
(ii) in
rule 36-E, in clause(a), for sub-clause (iii), the following shall be
substituted, namely:--
"(iii) all institutional investment shall be
discontinued with immediate effect.".
